description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and methods for WebSocket handling, including compression, decompression, masking, and script interpretation support.

classes.name: NoopMasker
classes.description: A masking class that returns the input string unchanged.

classes.name: RepeatedXorMasker
classes.description: A masking class that applies XOR with a repeating key, maintaining state across calls.

classes.name: _Deflater
classes.description: Handles compression using zlib with configurable window bits.

classes.name: _Inflater
classes.description: Handles decompression using zlib with configurable window bits.

classes.name: _RFC1979Deflater
classes.description: Compresses data following RFC1979 with optional no-context takeover.

classes.name: DeflateSocket
classes.description: A socket wrapper that performs transparent deflate compression and decompression.

methods.name: get_stack_trace
methods.description: Returns the current stack trace as a string.

methods.name: prepend_message_to_exception
methods.description: Prepends a message to an exception's args.

methods.name: __translate_interp
methods.description: Translates a program path for Cygwin or Windows Python environments.

methods.name: get_script_interp
methods.description: Reads a script's shebang line and returns the interpreted command, fixing paths if necessary.

methods.name: wrap_popen3_for_win
methods.description: Wraps os.popen3 to support #!-scripts on Windows.

methods.name: hexify
methods.description: Converts a string to its hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: get_class_logger
methods.description: Returns a logger for the class of the given object.
